summary: Complaints centre on broken link and village roads and on paddy soaked at Harduaganj sub-mandi; sourced local positives are few, led by a March 2026 interlocking-road inauguration in Thanpur and Hinsail.

positives.english: Interlocking roads have been built in Thanpur and Hinsail villages.
positives.hindi: थानपुर और हींसेल में इंटरलॉकिंग सड़कें बन गई हैं
positives.basis: Amar Ujala (16 Mar 2026): the Barauli MLA inaugurated a ~200 m interlocking road in Thanpur, stated as built from MLA fund, and a 600 m interlocking road from Hinsail to Nagla Sarua (funding not stated). A 1,600 m Hinsail-Nagla Sarua road only got a foundation stone, so it is not counted.

positives.english: A passenger shed and a barat ghar were built by the Barauli MLA.
positives.hindi: यात्री शेड और बारात घर विधायक ने बनवाए
positives.basis: Amar Ujala (26 Oct 2024) reporter states the Barauli MLA got a passenger shed, barat ghar and similar works built; the article covers three ACs and the line sits in its Barauli section. Reporter's statement only; no cost or completion date given.

positives.english: Farmers' paddy has already been bought at Harduaganj sub-mandi.
positives.hindi: हरदुआगंज उप मंडी में किसानों का धान खरीदा जा चुका है
positives.basis: Subkuz (13 Oct 2026) says the wet paddy kept at Harduaganj sub-mandi had already been bought from farmers. Weak positive: shows procurement took place, not that prices or payment were good.

positives.english: Construction of the Palwal-Aligarh highway has started.
positives.hindi: पलवल-अलीगढ़ हाईवे का निर्माण शुरू हो गया है
positives.basis: District-level, not confirmed inside Barauli AC: Amar Ujala (19 Jul 2025) says construction of NH 334D Palwal-Tappal-Aligarh (72 km, department target two years) started at Kheshwar crossing. Khair, Jattari, Andla, Arrana, Rajpura and Lodha are named; Barauli is not.

positives.english: *The first kilometre of the Harduaganj-Pipli-Bhamraula link road is built.
positives.hindi: *हरदुआगंज-पिपली-भमराउला संपर्क मार्ग का पहला किलोमीटर बन चुका है
positives.basis: Inference: a Newstrack search summary (about 100 days old, 2026) says the first 1 km of this 3.3 km link road is complete and the rest (2.3 km) awaits sanction from Mandi Parishad. The Newstrack page returned HTTP 403 on two attempts and was not opened, so no URL is cited. Harduaganj is in Barauli AC; Pipli and Bhamraula are not confirmed inside it.

negatives.english: The road has been broken for three years, and rainwater fills its potholes.
negatives.hindi: तीन साल से सड़क टूटी है, गड्ढों में बारिश का पानी भरता है
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala (30 Mar 2026): link road from a nagar panchayat (photo caption: Jawan) to the Barauli-Aligarh road, about 3 km, broken for three years; serves about six villages including Sumera and Faridpur. Gram pradhan says complaints were made many times with no action. AC membership: Wikipedia's Barauli extent lists Jawan Sikanderpur; the article itself does not name the nagar panchayat.

negatives.english: Paddy kept in the open at Harduaganj sub-mandi got soaked in the rain.
negatives.hindi: हरदुआगंज उप मंडी में खुले में रखा धान बारिश में भीगा
negatives.basis: Subkuz (13 Oct 2026): thousands of quintals of paddy kept in the open at Harduaganj sub-mandi were soaked by rain. The 20% loss fear and Rs 10 crore estimate in the article are for Khair mandi, so they are not used here. Harduaganj Nagar Panchayat is in Barauli AC per Wikipedia extent.

negatives.english: The Sadhu Ashram road in Kheda Bujurg is badly broken, and people keep falling and getting hurt on it.
negatives.hindi: खेड़ा बुजुर्ग साधु आश्रम मार्ग जर्जर है, आए दिन लोग चोटिल होते हैं
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala (26 Oct 2024): former Kheda Bujurg pradhan Chandrabhan Singh says 'साधु आश्रम मार्ग बेहद जर्जर है' and 'आए दिन लोग गिरकर चोटिल हो रहे हैं'. The article places Kheda Bujurg in its Barauli section; it covers three ACs, and no later report was found for this road.

negatives.english: The Memdi-Chhaleser, Mujaffara-Godha and Gopalpur-Kasimpur roads are broken.
negatives.hindi: मेमडी-छलेसर, मुजफ्फरा-गोधा, गोपालपुर-कासिमपुर सड़कें जर्जर हैं
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala (26 Oct 2024) lists these three roads under its own heading 'बरौली विधानसभा की जर्जर सड़कें' (dilapidated roads of Barauli assembly), with no speaker or individual description. Weak: a list, not a quote; field check needed. The article covers three ACs.

negatives.english: *Stray cattle destroy crops and farmers struggle to protect their fields.
negatives.hindi: *आवारा पशु खेत उजाड़ देते हैं, फसल बचाना मुश्किल
negatives.basis: Inference: no Barauli- or Aligarh-specific 2024-26 report was found in about 40 searches (Hindi and English). Only western and Bundelkhand UP coverage turned up. Not confirmed as a Barauli problem; a field check is needed.

notes: Thin local coverage. AC check: Wikipedia's Barauli (UP) extent begins 'KCs Barauli', includes 'PCs Harduaganj' and 'Harduaganj NP', and lists Jawan Sikanderpur; Kheda Bujurg, Khair and Lodha are not named there. Oct 2024 Amar Ujala article covers three ACs; its Barauli section supplies the Kheda Bujurg and Memdi/Mujaffara/Gopalpur road items. Positives are weak: P1 is a 2026 inauguration, P2 an MLA-linked shed reported in 2024, P3 shows only procurement, P4 is district-level and not confirmed in Barauli, P5 is an inference. Excluded: the Aug 2026 plaque-vandalism story (not appreciation, politics and police case); the 2022 handpump fluoride report (district-level, old); the 1,600 m Hinsail-Nagla Sarua road (foundation only); the 12-road Rs 21 crore tender (Kol and Atrauli ACs only); the Sep 2026 Sumera-area road story (no AC named; only the Jawan photo caption points to this area); the Aligarh ring road and Harduaganj boundary expansion (plans, not benefits). Field check priorities: Jawan link road, Kheda Bujurg Sadhu Ashram road, Memdi/Mujaffara/Gopalpur roads, Harduaganj sub-mandi storage and payment, Harduaganj-Pipli-Bhamraula road status, and the cattle inference. Edit pass: P3 weak positive: shows procurement only, not price or payment. N1 now names only the road and the three years; the link-road and Jawan details are left out of the statement.

round2.changes: Identity source changed to Wikipedia UP constituency page (no. 72, Aligarh, None; extent includes Harduaganj NP). Replaced P1 (MLA shed/hall, unverified years) and P2 (plaque vandalism story, removed) with Mar 2026 Thanpur/Hinsail interlocking-road inauguration; P2 now the Oct 2024 shed/barat ghar line. Removed Jul 2022 handpump source (district-level, old). N3 reworded to what Subkuz states for Harduaganj (soaking); 20% loss fear is Khair, dropped. Added N4 from the Oct 2024 article's Barauli dilapidated-roads heading. Jawan road AC basis clarified. Re-ranked positives and negatives. Cattle inference kept; no sourced Barauli cattle report found. Harduaganj-Pipli-Bhamraula Newstrack page still HTTP 403, kept as inference.
